evidence: In the tranquil grounds of Văn Miếu Quốc Tử Giám, a revered institution of learning and cultural heritage, Long Van Khe Hoi stands as a striking contemporary installation, harmoniously blending the past and present. This magnificent bamboo structure, inspired by the drifting clouds and soaring dragons of Vietnamese mythology, wraps around an ancient tree, evoking the convergence of heaven and earth.
